chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad ibn 'Uthman from 'Ubaydullah al-Halabi from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"There is no harm in praying over the corpses when the sun sets and when it rises; it is merely seeking forgiveness."

key_terms.حِينَ تَغِيبُ الشَّمْسُ: When the sun sets (time of sunset)

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to pray funeral prayers when the sun is rising or setting?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies that funeral prayers are valid during the four times of prohibition (waqt al-karaha), specifically refuting the view that they are invalid during sunrise and sunset. By characterizing the prayer primarily as *istighfar* (seeking forgiveness), the Imam underscores its spiritual function of intercession, which remains effective regardless of the specific time of day.
